nodes.label: Unbreakable Name-Checkbox Unit
nodes.author: s-a-c
nodes.rationale: Binds checkbox, status indicator, and ellipsis-truncated skill name inside a single nowrap flex unit (.skill-title-unit / .result-title-unit) and height=1 TUI rows so narrow panes down to 10% never detach checkboxes from their labels.

nodes.label: Skill Provenance Taxonomy & Removal Guardrail
nodes.author: s-a-c
nodes.rationale: Classifies installed skills by lstat symlink check first (linked), then lockfile presence (locked), else local, displaying provenance badges/filters and gating rm of linked/local skills behind explicit user confirmation.

nodes.label: v0.5.4.1 Design: List-Card Ergonomics & Split-Pane Parity
nodes.author: s-a-c
nodes.norm_label: v0.5.4.1 design: list-card ergonomics & split-pane parity
nodes.rationale: Design specification ratified in Linear S-257 (map S-256) resolving detached checkboxes, pixel-bound list widths, stacked search card layouts, and TUI/WebUI split-pane and sorting divergence.

nodes.label: v0.5.5 Design: Hub Integration, Provenance Guardrails & Health Strip
nodes.author: s-a-c
nodes.norm_label: v0.5.5 design: hub integration, provenance guardrails & health strip
nodes.rationale: Ratified design specification (Linear S-313, map S-312, tickets S-314-S-319) bridging skills-ui with curated multi-harness skill hubs while keeping the public OSS codebase strictly generic and decoupled from personal dotfiles or chezmoi.

nodes.label: Contiguous Right-Justified Action Group (.result-foot)
nodes.author: s-a-c
nodes.rationale: Uses declarative CSS Flexbox (.result-source with margin-right:auto and .result-actions with flex-wrap:nowrap + margin-left:auto inside .result-foot) to merge actions onto the penultimate line when wide and drop them together flush right when narrow, rejecting ResizeObserver to avoid drag layout thrash.
nodes.source_location: ### Alternative B: Use a JavaScript `ResizeObserver` to Toggle `.result-actions` Between Lines

nodes.label: Proportional 10%-50% List Width & Legacy Pixel Migration
nodes.author: s-a-c
nodes.norm_label: proportional 10%-50% list width & legacy pixel migration
nodes.rationale: Stores UiPreferences.listWidth as a 10..50 integer percentage (null = 35%) shared across WebUI --list-col and TUI panes; normalizes legacy v0.5.4 pixel values (> 50) to null instead of clamping to 50% so upgrades do not distort existing user layouts.

nodes.label: TUI Split-Pane Search & 3-Mode Sort Parity
nodes.author: s-a-c
nodes.rationale: Converts SearchBody to a two-pane split keeping Results and install list (N) in the left scrollbox (preserving Tab navigation and 80-col pty-smoke invariants rather than using a modal), adds Detail Panel with sibling sourceSkills discovery, and adds 3-mode sort cycling (checked -> name -> load) with memoized visibleResults.

nodes.label: Global Lockfile Resolution (.skill-lock.json Primary)
nodes.author: s-a-c
nodes.rationale: Updates globalLockPath() to prefer $XDG_STATE_HOME/skills/.skill-lock.json written by stock skills v1.9.0 and fall back to skills-lock.json only when absent, fixing blind global update checks while preserving InvalidLockFileError.

nodes.label: Read-Only Health Strip (SKILLS_UI_HEALTH_CMD & Health Pill)
nodes.author: s-a-c
nodes.rationale: Exposes host-env health probe via GET /api/health-check (10s TTL cache, 15s timeout, full 0.5.1 Host/CORS/Bearer/rate-limit enforcement), advertises only capability booleans via GET /api/version without leaking paths, and renders a compact header Health Pill hidden when unconfigured.

nodes.label: Host-Env Post-Mutation Hook (SKILLS_UI_POST_MUTATION_HOOK)
nodes.author: s-a-c
nodes.rationale: Reads hook path strictly from host process env (never prefs.json or HTTP to uphold 0.5.1 security), invokes Bun.spawn directly without /bin/sh -c (30s timeout, stripped from stock skills subprocess env to prevent recursion), and reports failures as non-fatal warning toasts and API hook telemetry.

nodes.label: Client State Store
nodes.rationale: Single in-memory state object holding UI selections, preferences, capabilities, install queue, agent/provenance filters, and scope-keyed update caches (UI-07) so project and global rows with identical names remain isolated.

nodes.label: TUI/Web Filter Parity Predicate (skillMatches)
nodes.rationale: Transpiled directly from src/web/page.ts and verified by tests/filter-parity.test.ts so Web UI and TUI share the exact same case-insensitive match set across name, source, agents, and description.

nodes.label: Escape-First Safe Markdown Renderer
nodes.rationale: Zero-dependency SKILL.md renderer that escapes every text token via esc() before emitting tags, renders links as non-navigating spans to honor default-src 'none' CSP, avoids raw backticks inside template literals, and drops the link regex branch when no '](' is present to prevent O(n^2) backtracking (S-165).

nodes.label: User Timing Filter Render Instrumentation
nodes.rationale: Emits and clears skills-ui:filter-render User Timing marks/measures around every debounced renderList pass so scripts/perf can measure pure render work excluding debounce and frame pacing without exhausting browser performance entry buffers (S-180).

nodes.label: WebAudio Synthesized Sound Effects
nodes.rationale: Generates select, confirm, success, and error tones via WebAudio oscillators so the single-file dashboard needs no external audio assets.

nodes.label: CLI Seed Handoff
nodes.rationale: Consumes server-injected window.__SEED__ payloads (add, update, remove) at boot, opening source picker for add or intersecting update/remove targets against live installed skills to stay in parity with TUI model.ts pruning (G5, S-187).

nodes.label: Remove Confirmation Dialog
nodes.rationale: Modal confirmation gate for single or batch skill deletion that appends nonLockedWarning when any targeted skill has linked or local provenance.

nodes.label: Hosted Backend Connect Dialog
nodes.rationale: Guides hosted-mode users to pair the GitHub Pages UI with a local skills-ui serve URL and Hosted-UI Bearer token, surfacing targeted diagnostics for allowlist rejections, old binaries, bad tokens, and Safari local-network blocks (S-137).

nodes.label: Skill & Search Detail Pane
nodes.rationale: Displays installed skill metadata, conditional Update/Remove actions (S-186), and rendered SKILL.md via showDetail, or registry skill details and sibling source discovery via showSearchDetail, or CLI seed installation via showInstallSeed.

nodes.label: Hosted Mode & Loopback API Bridge
nodes.rationale: Detects non-loopback HOSTED origins, attaches Bearer tokens to loopback backend calls, and stores credentials strictly in sessionStorage (migrating and clearing legacy localStorage) because s-a-c.github.io is a shared origin where sibling pages could otherwise steal tokens (0.5.1 impl B, S-137).

nodes.label: Hub Health Check Popover
nodes.rationale: Capability-gated (capabilities.healthCheck) status pill and detail dialog that refreshes on boot and after every mutation via handlePostMutation, surfacing post-mutation hook failures as error toasts.

nodes.label: Global & Delegated Keyboard Navigation
nodes.rationale: Provides global shortcuts (/, f, g/p, a, i, x, ?, Esc preserving filter/search text), accessible splitter arrow/Home/End keys, and delegated list Enter/Space handling that yields to native descendant controls so Space toggles row checkboxes (UI-06, S-207).

nodes.label: Master List & Search Pane
nodes.rationale: Unifies Installed skills (#skillList) and Registry Search (#results) in one left pane with shared sort controls, provenance filter (#provRow), agent filter popover (#agentsPop), and a fixed-height permanent .list-head Select-all master checkbox plus inline selection summary (#selSummary) so selection changes never shift layout (S-186, S-187).

nodes.label: Registry Search & Batch Install Queue
nodes.rationale: Debounced (300ms) registry search with in-place installed/update status indicators (A6), sibling skill discovery via /api/source-skills, and sequential source-grouped batch installation (installQueue).

nodes.label: Local skills-ui Serve REST API
nodes.rationale: HTTP JSON contract exposed by local skills-ui serve (/api/version, /api/prefs, /api/health-check, /api/skills, /api/skill, /api/updates, /api/search, /api/source-skills, /api/install, /api/update, /api/remove), passing exact cached row path on /api/skill for server validation (S-179).

nodes.label: Settings Drawer
nodes.rationale: Slide-over modal drawer (#scrim) persisting Theme, Sound effects, Reduce motion, List pane width, and fixed Server port preferences via PUT /api/prefs.

nodes.label: Resizable Split-Pane Layout
nodes.rationale: CSS Grid master-detail layout with an accessible pointer-and-keyboard vertical splitter (#listSplitter) clamping #listPane width between 10% and 50% (default 35%) and persisting via debounced prefs (S-238).

nodes.label: Toast Notification System
nodes.rationale: Polite aria-live status toasts that encode tone via border and indicator dot (>=3:1) while keeping body text on AA-verified --t-text over --t-surfaceAlt, clipping long CLI outputs with clip().

nodes.label: Top Header Bar
nodes.rationale: Sticky navigation bar housing Installed/Search tabs, Project/Global scope toggle, bulk actions, Hub Health pill, and 32px icon-only inline SVG controls (ICONS, no emoji glyphs per sloplint 30a) that wrap below 720px (S-186).

nodes.label: Skill Update & Removal Workflow
nodes.rationale: Handles update checks (surfacing failures and per-row error tooltips per G4/ST4), updates, and single/batch removals, treating HTTP 200 with ok:false as explicit CLI failures (G2/ST3) and running post-mutation health checks.

nodes.label: Skills UI Web Dashboard
nodes.rationale: Single-file self-contained web dashboard (v0.5.5) that works both locally from skills-ui serve and remotely on GitHub Pages in hosted mode with zero external runtime assets.

nodes.label: Monotonic Generation Tokens for Async Races
nodes.norm_label: monotonic generation tokens for async races
nodes.rationale: Guards asynchronous list loads (skillsLoadSeq), detail fetches (detailSeq + ownsDetail, S-204), registry searches (searchSeq, S-182), scope-keyed update checks (updateCheckSeq, UI-07), and batch install scope snapshots (installGlobally, S-202) so stale responses never overwrite newer UI state.

nodes.label: Catppuccin Theme & Motion System
nodes.rationale: Uses Catppuccin Mocha and Latte CSS tokens with light-theme accents darkened to pass WCAG AA contrast, aligns all padding/margin/gap values on a 4px Hallmark scale (S-181), and forces animation-iteration-count: 1 when reduced motion is active so infinite loops stop cleanly instead of flickering.

nodes.label: Content Security Policy (CSP)
nodes.rationale: Enforces default-src 'none', SHA-256 hashed inline scripts, no-referrer, base-uri 'none', form-action 'none', and restricts network calls to loopback (127.0.0.1 and localhost) so the hosted dashboard cannot exfiltrate data or navigate.

nodes.label: Keyed DOM-Reuse List Reconciler
nodes.rationale: Reconciles #skillList rows by scope/name key using rowByKey, content-only rowSignature diffing, 150ms debounced filtering, delegated list listeners, and one-shot .rise-in entrance classes (stripped before moving connected nodes) to avoid rebuilding ~390 DOM rows and ~1.6k listeners per keystroke (S-180, S-186).

nodes.label: Pre-Paint Script Gate (.js)
nodes.rationale: Scopes the off-screen hidden state of #settings to the .js class added before first paint (gate 62), keeping drawer content visible in place when scripting is disabled.

nodes.label: Single Button Disabled-State Writer (UI-05)
nodes.rationale: Computes button.disabled = state.busy || data-semantic-disabled === 'true' through one writer (syncButtonDisabled/syncButtons) so clearing transient busy state never re-enables semantically disabled buttons and buttons inserted mid-flight inherit busy state (S-206).

nodes.label: Upstream Issue Draft: skills ls O(canonical x corpus) Re-Parse Storm
nodes.norm_label: upstream issue draft: skills ls o(canonical x corpus) re-parse storm
nodes.rationale: Ready-to-file upstream bug report cross-referencing vercel-labs/skills#1389, presenting bisection timings (0.26s to 63.5s), duplicate warning storms (222-223 repeats), sample(1) I/O wait profile, and O(canonical x corpus) re-parse root cause in listInstalledSkills.

nodes.label: Upstream Memo: vercel-labs/skills#2644 (S-153)
nodes.rationale: Filed upstream as vercel-labs/skills#2644 proposing per-path parseSkillMd memoization and a per-agent name->dir index to reduce full-home skills ls read amplification from ~60s to ~2.4s.

nodes.label: Real-Corpus Performance Budget Report (2026-11-01)
nodes.rationale: S-177 benchmark against real skills CLI (1 project + 300 global skills, 0.5.2) meeting 10/11 budgets and exposing cold global perceived first paint miss (62,471.2 ms vs 300 ms budget; warm global API 1.2 ms vs 78,439.2 ms cold).

nodes.label: Synthetic Performance Budget Report (2026-11-01)
nodes.rationale: S-177 baseline benchmark against skills-shim fixtures (390 project + 40 global skills, 0.5.2) recording 7/11 MET and 4 pre-fix BUDGET-MISS rows (concurrent search dedup, filter full rebuilds, animation replays, stale search overwrite).

nodes.label: Downstream Serve List Cache & In-Flight Coalescing
nodes.norm_label: downstream serve list cache & in-flight coalescing
nodes.rationale: Preserves the wrap-don't-fork boundary by caching one ls --json result per scope per server, coalescing concurrent list requests onto one spawn, reusing cached before-set on remove, and invalidating only on mutations.
nodes.source_location: ## What skills-ui did meanwhile (downstream, not a fix)

nodes.label: Linear Planning Plane (P-S-4 & Wayfinder Maps)
nodes.rationale: Linear project skills-ui (P-S-4) is the canonical planning plane for milestones (0.1.x-0.5.x), project documents, and wayfinder:map decision trees with native blocking relations.

nodes.label: SKILLS_UI_* Environment Variables
nodes.rationale: All project-owned environment variables take the SKILLS_UI_ prefix (SKILLS_UI_SKILLS_BIN, SKILLS_UI_PREFS_DIR, SKILLS_UI_API_URL, SKILLS_UI_SPAWN_QUEUE_CAP, SKILLS_UI_POST_MUTATION_HOOK, SKILLS_UI_HEALTH_CMD), while standard/third-party vars keep conventional names; hook and health executables are restricted to host env only.

nodes.label: Contiguous Action Group
nodes.rationale: Non-breaking right-justified action button group on a Filter List Card that sits on the last line when narrow and merges onto the Penultimate Card Line when horizontal space permits without wrapping individual buttons.

nodes.label: Filter List Panel
nodes.rationale: Left-hand pane of the Frame hosting filter/search inputs, sort controls, selection summary, and Filter List Cards, with user-adjustable proportional width between 10% and 50% of the Frame (default 35%).

nodes.label: Health Pill (SKILLS_UI_HEALTH_CMD / GET /api/health-check)
nodes.rationale: Compact header status indicator driven by host-env SKILLS_UI_HEALTH_CMD via GET /api/health-check and hidden completely when unset; refreshes automatically after mutations and toggles a read-only detail view on click (WebUI) or H (TUI).

nodes.label: Name-Checkbox Unit
nodes.rationale: Unbreakable leading inline group on a Filter List Card pairing the selection checkbox, optional status dot, and skill name so they never wrap onto separate lines; constrained names truncate with an ellipsis while secondary badges wrap below.

nodes.label: Post-Mutation Hook (SKILLS_UI_POST_MUTATION_HOOK)
nodes.rationale: Optional executable supplied solely via host process environment (never HTTP or prefs.json), invoked directly via Bun.spawn without a shell after successful install, remove, or update mutations; failures surface as non-fatal warning toasts and telemetry rather than reverting CLI changes.

nodes.label: Skill Provenance (locked, linked, local)
nodes.rationale: Filesystem and lockfile origin of an installed skill derived from lstat(skill.path) and readLock(scope); distinguishes lockfile-tracked real directories (locked), symlinks (linked), and untracked real directories (local), requiring explicit removal confirmation for linked and local skills in WebUI and TUI.

nodes.label: Tag-Pinned Checksum-Verified Installer
nodes.rationale: Recommends pinning scripts/install.sh to a signed release tag so git tag -v covers both the installer script and the checksum manifest verifying the downloaded binary.

nodes.label: Subprocess Wrapper Architecture (Wrap Don't Fork)
nodes.rationale: Wraps the stock vercel-labs/skills CLI strictly via subprocess with zero build-time dependency, shipping one Bun-compiled binary with three modes (OpenTUI TUI, --web local WebUI, serve headless HTTP API) and 0.x.y forever versioning.

nodes.label: 0.5.1 Accepted-Risk Ledger (S-148)
nodes.rationale: Records ten explicitly accepted residual security risks with revisit triggers (no token rotation on loopback, no CI, cleartext loopback, token-free /api/version, mitigated curl|sh, loopback-wide connect-src, meta CSP frame-ancestors, stale exif-parser, Host-header-null pass-through, absolute paths in /api/skills) after implementing rate limiting and subprocess serialization.

nodes.label: 0.5.2 Deferred Consistency Items & Hallmark 24b Waiver
nodes.rationale: Documents deferred polish-tier gaps (web listbox ARIA arrow keys, TUI mouse parity, motion tri-state, TUI sound wiring, busy-model unification, runtime-string dash sweep) and formally waives Hallmark gate 24b 4px re-space (57 instances) as a restyle-depth change slated for 0.5.3.

nodes.label: Ratified Cross-Surface Vocabulary & Filter Parity (S-152)
nodes.rationale: Enforces shared terminology across WebUI and TUI (install list, remove verb, key-accurate confirm copy), guarantees identical filter results across both surfaces via filter-parity.test.ts, and requires Hallmark sloplint cleanliness on docs/app.html.
nodes.source_location: # Gates: 0.5.2 — UI/UX consistency (web + TUI), map S-143

nodes.label: Ratified Performance Budget Table & Two-State Verdict Model (S-155)
nodes.norm_label: ratified performance budget table & two-state verdict model (s-155)
nodes.rationale: Evaluates all 13 hot paths strictly as MET (11/11 synthetic budgets + real warm list 0.1 ms, detail 0.2 ms, TUI SWR index load 0.504 ms) or ACCEPTED-WITH-REASON (upstream skills ls --json -g 62-103 s floor due to wrap-don't-fork, skills.sh network RTT, TUI whole-tree re-render), enforced by a CI-strict synthetic harness and a CI-refused --real probe.

nodes.label: Local Network Access (LNA) Permission & Connect Flow
nodes.norm_label: local network access (lna) permission & connect flow
nodes.rationale: Automates real-origin Playwright e2e verification for LNA grant, wrong-token rejection, and no-grant LNA blocking so only the native browser LNA permission prompt click requires manual human verification (G7).

nodes.label: Serve Request Hardening (S-156 / 0.5.1 impl A)
nodes.rationale: Hardens the local HTTP API boundary with no-Origin cross-site sec-fetch-site 403 rejection, source/name shape validation (400), 1 MiB transport body cap (413), global token-bucket rate limiter (429), serialized capped spawn queue (503), timing-safe Bearer compare, generic 500 bodies, outbound fetch timeouts, and segment-encoded GitHub trees URLs.
nodes.source_location: # Gates: 0.5.1 impl A — serve request hardening (S-156)

nodes.label: Hosted Page Hardening (S-157 / 0.5.1 impl B)
nodes.rationale: Replaces script-src unsafe-inline with SHA-256 hash-pinned CSP and base-uri/form-action none, scopes Hosted-UI token storage to sessionStorage with one-time legacy migration, escapes </script> in embedded JSON via safeJsonEmbed, and adds nosniff/referrer headers on GET /.
nodes.source_location: # Gates: 0.5.1 impl B — hosted page hardening (S-157)

nodes.label: Installer & Release Trust Chain (S-158 / 0.5.1 impl C)
nodes.norm_label: installer & release trust chain (s-158 / 0.5.1 impl c)
nodes.rationale: Commits checksum manifests into the git tree before signing the release tag (build -> commit -> sign-tag -> publish) so verification does not rely solely on mutable release assets, paired with atomic same-directory installation in scripts/install.sh.
nodes.source_location: # Gates: 0.5.1 impl C — installer + release trust (S-158)

nodes.label: Ingress Metadata & Terminal Escape Sanitization (S-159 / 0.5.1 impl D)
nodes.norm_label: ingress metadata & terminal escape sanitization (s-159 / 0.5.1 impl d)
nodes.rationale: Centralizes ANSI CSI/OSC/DCS/C1 escape and control-byte scrubbing in sanitize.ts across every external-text ingress (ls --json, cyan-parsed sources, add --json, update output, frontmatter descriptions, SKILL.md bodies) to block terminal and UI injection.
nodes.source_location: # Gates: 0.5.1 impl D — metadata sanitization on all ingress (S-159)

nodes.label: TUI Install-Scope Threading & Double-Press Quit Guard (S-161 / 0.5.2 impl A)
nodes.norm_label: tui install-scope threading & double-press quit guard (s-161 / 0.5.2 impl a)
nodes.rationale: Threads the [g]/[p] scope toggle through TUI install paths into svcInstall({global}) without modifying core install semantics, and guards against accidental single-keystroke quit while filtering via an armed double-press q.
nodes.source_location: # Gates: S-161 — 0.5.2 impl A, TUI correctness (install scope + q-guard)

nodes.label: TUI Sort Indicator, Vocabulary Sweep & Toast FIFO Queue (S-162 / 0.5.2 impl B)
nodes.norm_label: tui sort indicator, vocabulary sweep & toast fifo queue (s-162 / 0.5.2 impl b)
nodes.rationale: Shows compact idle-state sort indicators fitting the 19-char 80-col border title budget (N skills·checked / N skills·order), eliminates legacy queue/Selected/Delete literals, adds n/N cancel on remove-confirm, and queues toasts FIFO in a single slot so notifications are never clobbered.
nodes.source_location: # Gates: S-162 — 0.5.2 impl B, TUI polish (sort indicator, naming, confirm-n, toast queue)

nodes.label: WebUI Response Honesty & Update-Check Feedback (S-163 / 0.5.2 impl C)
nodes.norm_label: webui response honesty & update-check feedback (s-163 / 0.5.2 impl c)
nodes.rationale: Requires every /api/remove and /api/update handler in APP_JS to check response body ok before showing success toasts, surfaces zero/failure update-check feedback with manual force refresh, pre-checks remove seeds, and re-renders stale install buttons.
nodes.source_location: # Gates: S-163 — 0.5.2 impl C, web honesty (res.ok checks, update-check feedback, seed pre-check)

nodes.label: Performance Caching, Coalescing & SWR Architecture
nodes.rationale: Mitigates upstream vercel-labs/skills#2644 scan overhead via per-scope serve caching and read coalescing (0.1 ms warm hit), zero-subprocess exact-path detail reads, TUI persisted disk-index SWR (~0.5 ms paint), keyed web filter reconciliation, and in-flight search deduplication with stale-response guards.

nodes.label: Serial Defog-First Hardening Series (0.5.1-0.5.3)
nodes.rationale: Sequences 0.5.x hardening strictly as security (0.5.1) -> UI/UX consistency (0.5.2) -> performance (0.5.3), starting each map with read-only audits and closing on a signed patch release and gate ledger.

nodes.label: Hosted Zero-Install WebUI Architecture & Guardrails
nodes.rationale: Static GitHub Pages app talking to loopback-bound single-user skills-ui serve via browser Local Network Access (Chrome 142+/Edge/Firefox 153+; Safari blocked by WebKit 171934) with plain CORS (Vary: Origin), RFC 6750 Bearer auth, Host allowlist, and proxied skills.sh search; permanently excludes multi-user remote serving, hosted search backends, and TUI-in-browser.

nodes.label: 0.x.y Indefinite Versioning Policy
nodes.rationale: Minor versions denote milestones and patches denote fixes; breaking changes are permitted at any minor and no 1.0 stability contract is implied.

nodes.label: Upstream skills ls Memoization Report
nodes.rationale: Documents reproducible upstream skills CLI ls slowdown (279/300 rows, 223 duplicate warnings) in docs/upstream-ls-memoization.md while retaining the wrap-don't-fork architecture.

nodes.label: Signed-Tag Checksum Trust Path
nodes.rationale: From v0.5.1 onward, shasum-compatible sha256 manifests are committed at the tagged commit so a signed git tag covers both tree and checksums; scripts/install.sh verifies against this committed manifest first to separate trust verification from the GitHub release-asset bucket, falling back to release assets only for older tags.

nodes.label: Esc-Keeps-Text Input Rule and 3-Mode Checked-First Sort
nodes.norm_label: esc-keeps-text input rule and 3-mode checked-first sort
nodes.rationale: Aligns web Escape handlers with help documentation by keeping filter and search query text on Escape, removes dead duplicate checkForUpdates code, and flips default web sort to checked-first with A-to-Z tiebreak matching the TUI while providing real A-Z and load-order modes.

nodes.label: Single-Source skillMatches Cross-Surface Filter Parity
nodes.rationale: Exports skillMatches() at src/web/page.ts module scope and interpolates its transpiled .toString() into APP_JS so web and TUI share one filter predicate (including agents in the web haystack); enforced by node --check, sha256 script pinning, and 12x3 cross-surface parity tests.

nodes.label: Escape-First Zero-Dependency Markdown Renderer
nodes.rationale: 136-LOC zero-dependency renderer inside APP_JS escaping through esc() at every branch with class-only static tags, non-navigating links (no href under CSP posture), unicode-escaped backtick fences (u0060) to preserve template-literal integrity, and gated link matching (canLink) to avoid O(n^2) unmatched-bracket scans.

nodes.label: Discriminated Search-Failure Signal
nodes.rationale: Distinguishes upstream skills.sh search failures (fetch throw and HTTP !res.ok) from zero results via a discriminated-absent failed flag on primary queries only, keeping success JSON byte-identical to 0.5.1 while rendering explicit failure messaging on both web and TUI.

nodes.label: Update-Check Error Rendering and Bound-Port Surfacing
nodes.norm_label: update-check error rendering and bound-port surfacing
nodes.rationale: Renders per-skill update-check errors and not-checkable counts on both web and TUI, raises skills ls timeout from 120s to 300s, and passes the synchronous Bun.serve boundPort into rendered pages so settings hints report the actual bound port.

nodes.label: Hallmark Sloplint Floor Pass and Gate 24b Waiver
nodes.norm_label: hallmark sloplint floor pass and gate 24b waiver
nodes.rationale: Resolves 15 FAIL and 6 WARN sloplint findings via unified hairline-edges styling, AA contrast logo mark, em/en-dash removal in static copy ('A to Z'), and .md-quote restyling, while explicitly stamping a temporary 57-instance gate 24b spacing waiver in emitted CSS.

nodes.label: 11-Row Synthetic and Real Performance Budget Harness
nodes.norm_label: 11-row synthetic and real performance budget harness
nodes.rationale: Measures 11 ratified budget rows using a deterministic skills-shim (390+40 synthetic default) and CI-refused --real corpus mode, paired with count/behavior-only perf tests (zero wall-clock thresholds in tests/perf) and committed baseline report-2026-11-01.md recording 7 MET and 4 BUDGET-MISS rows.

nodes.label: Per-Server Scope List Cache with Generation-Guarded Coalescing
nodes.norm_label: per-server scope list cache with generation-guarded coalescing
nodes.rationale: Eliminates repeated 48-63s skills ls --json subprocess spawns in src/core/api.ts via per-server per-scope copy-on-read caching, scope-keyed in-flight request coalescing, generation-guarded invalidation on every mutation, and injectable before/after listers in remove(), dropping warm global list latency from ~50-60s to 1.0 ms.

nodes.label: Compare-Only Exact-Match /api/skill Path Lookup
nodes.rationale: Web client sends both name and path to preserve compatibility with older serve binaries; /api/skill resolves path by strict === membership against S-178 cached rows without reading arbitrary paths on disk, achieving 0-spawn warm detail clicks (0.24 ms) while rejecting traversal/prefix/suffix probes with 404.

nodes.label: 150ms Debounced Keyed DOM Reconcile and First-Paint-Only Cascade
nodes.norm_label: 150ms debounced keyed dom reconcile and first-paint-only cascade
nodes.rationale: Replaces full ~390-row list rebuilds per keystroke with a 150ms trailing debounce, signature-keyed row reconciliation (rowSignature), User Timing instrumentation (skills-ui:filter-render ~0.9-1.0 ms median), and first-paint-only .rise-in entrance cascade so animation replays drop from 10 to 0 while keeping first-load animation and row focus.

nodes.label: 4px Spacing Scale Re-Space and Header Height Compensation
nodes.norm_label: 4px spacing scale re-space and header height compensation
nodes.rationale: Retires the S-168 page-wide gate 24b waiver (57 waived to 0) by snapping all >2px APP_CSS and inline paddings, margins, and gaps to 4px multiples and adjusting main height calc from 61px to 66px to eliminate 7px bottom overflow.

nodes.label: Service-Layer Search Coalescing and Monotonic searchSeq Guard
nodes.norm_label: service-layer search coalescing and monotonic searchseq guard
nodes.rationale: Deduplicates identical concurrent upstream searches inside searchRegistryFuzzy (clearing on settle, never memoizing failures) and guards both web and TUI consumers with monotonic sequence tokens (searchSeq) so late stale responses cannot overwrite newer results, toasts, or install-owned busy state; brings synthetic perf budget to 11/11 MET.

nodes.label: Persisted Disk-Index Stale-While-Revalidate and model.visible Memo
nodes.norm_label: persisted disk-index stale-while-revalidate and model.visible memo
nodes.rationale: Paints a persisted atomic per-scope disk index (~0.13 ms median load, statSync size-guarded, written only from fresh subprocess truth) while skills ls refreshes asynchronously with seen-set checked reconciliation and loadSeq race protection, plus memoizes visibleSkills once per dispatch (-53% keystroke model cost).

nodes.label: Single-Pass Lexer Runtime-Dash Sweep Gate
nodes.rationale: Replaces en/em dashes in 17 user-facing runtime strings across APP_JS and TUI with clause punctuation per Hallmark gate 19 and prevents regressions with a single-pass lexer test catching U+2013/U+2014, unicode escapes, and HTML entities alongside a vacuous-pass corpus guard.

nodes.label: Row Signature Refresh Fix, Outdated-Only Detail Update, and Top-Bar Layout
nodes.norm_label: row signature refresh fix, outdated-only detail update, and top-bar layout
nodes.rationale: Fixes the Clear-button visual-checkbox bug by recomputing li.__sig immediately when state.checked mutates, gates detail Update button markup and listener on detailOutdated, replaces text glyphs with inline SVGs (Hallmark gate 30a), adds a 35% list pane and tri-state master checkbox, and hardens S-183 swap-reconcile tests to await fresh detail body.

nodes.label: Height-Stable Selection Line Merge and TUI Checked-Count Parity
nodes.norm_label: height-stable selection line merge and tui checked-count parity
nodes.rationale: Removes #selBar by folding selection count and Clear into the permanent .list-head row (structural height stability via 21px checkbox margin-box plus narrow-viewport label hiding at <=560px/<=480px), surfaces checked counts in TUI pane titles via checkedTitle under the 19-char budget ladder, and intersects web update-seed with installed skills to match TUI prune semantics.

nodes.label: Wayfinder Map Convention
nodes.rationale: Structures milestone decisions as wayfinder:map parent issues with typed child tickets (research, prototype, grilling, task), native blockedBy relations, one ticket per session, and decision gists appended on close.

nodes.label: Signed Release & Dual Trust-Path Procedure (v0.5.1+)
nodes.rationale: Separates binary distribution (GitHub release assets) from integrity verification (checksums/checksums-<ver>.txt committed and covered by signed git tag git tag -s), requiring all-platform frozen install (--os='*' --cpu='*' --libc='*') before building the four-target matrix and exporting docs/app.html.

nodes.label: PTY Smoke Test Harness (S-95)
nodes.rationale: Forks skills-ui inside a real PTY driven by pyte (runner.py, smoke.py, skills-smoke-bin.ts) over a 120-skill fixture corpus because the in-memory bun test renderer is not faithful to real terminal rendering.

nodes.label: ADR Conflict Flagging Rule
nodes.rationale: Any proposal or output contradicting an existing ADR must be explicitly surfaced rather than silently overriding recorded architectural decisions.

nodes.label: Workspace Instruction Priority & SKILLS_UI_ Convention
nodes.rationale: Establishes a four-tier contract hierarchy (explicit user/orchestrator > global AGENTS.md > workspace docs/agents/workspace.md > repo AGENTS.md) and reserves the SKILLS_UI_ prefix for all project-owned environment variables.

nodes.label: PTY Harness Gotchas & Contracts
